Summaries.eng: Rookie office lady Momo-chan and veteran office lady Ume-san are good friends of different generations. Ume-san accepts Momo-chan, who is doing her best in everything, but is slightly out of alignment, with her unfathomable love and tsukkomi. Draw loosely by changing there is work such as complaints and dissatisfaction that unfolds in the office into laughter and love. It is a prescription drama of the heart that is familiar, bright, fun, and light.
Summaries.jpn: 新人OLの桃ちゃんとベテランOLの梅さんは世代の違う仲良しです。 梅さんは、全力を尽くしているモモちゃんを受け入れますが、計り知れない愛情とツッコミで少しずれています。 オフィスで繰り広げられる苦情や不満などの仕事が笑いと愛に変わることで、ゆるく描いてください。 なじみがあり、明るく、楽しく、そして軽い心の処方ドラマです。

Titles.jpn: マウンティングマウンテン／スイーツ des 自己診断

Summaries.eng: The first day of work, Ume (Noriko Eguchi) tries to rush to the company cafeteria, but Momo (Sari Ito) asks her to give her two minutes. When she went to the hot water supply room, she heard that the Mount Girls (Megu Aoyama) were talking about the holidays. Momo excitedly reports the details of the mounting battle, and tuts at them. Then, Ume starts talking about her "very unexpected past"...! Sweets des Self-Diagnosis: While Ume is working, Momo, who is wearing a trench coat for some reason, hides in a gap in the desk and speaks to her in a whisper. In fact, Momo was apparently annoyed at being forced to work overtime by her boss (Minagawa Sarutoki) and had gone to buy a large quantity of sweets during her shift. Furthermore, Momo tells Ume that she can self-diagnose what kind of anger she has been building up by deciding which sweets she wants to eat...?
Summaries.jpn: 【マウンティングマウンテン】昼休み、急いで社食に行こうとするウメ (江口のりこ) に、モモ (伊藤沙莉) が「2分だけください」と言ってきた。なんでも給湯室へ行ったら、マウント女子 (青山めぐ) たちが連休の話題でマウントを取り合っていたらしい。興奮気味に詳細を報告しながら、マウント合戦にツッコみまくるモモ。すると、ウメが“超意外な過去”を語りだし…!【スイーツ des 自己診断】ウメが仕事をしていると、なぜかトレンチコート姿のモモがデスクの隙間に隠れながら、小声で話しかけてきた。実はモモ、部長 (皆川猿時) に残業を押し付けられてイライラし、勤務中にスイーツを大量に買いに行っていたらしい。さらに、モモはウメに「どのスイーツを食べたいかで、どんなうっぷんを溜めているか自己診断できる」と切り出し…!?

Titles.eng: Perfectionism is a bad idea / Areole fraud
Titles.jpn: 完璧主義はダメ／アレオレ詐欺

Summaries.eng: Ume (Noriko Eguchi) asks Momo (Sari Ito) to prepare materials for submission to the director (Sarutoki Minagawa), and when she is asked to confirm her progress 15 minutes before the deadline, Momo becomes clumsy... Momo (Sari Ito), who has been asked to prepare a document for submission, is in a daze when she is asked to confirm progress 15 minutes before the deadline... Momo starts to answer the phone in front of Ume and gives an impassioned speech to the caller, who says she will submit the document at the last minute, saying "I know you want to be particular but perfectionism is not good"...! The caller said, "I understand that you want to be particular, but perfectionism is not a good thing..." and then he made an impassioned speech.
Summaries.jpn: 【完璧主義はダメ】ウメ (江口のりこ) から部長 (皆川猿時) に提出する資料の作成を頼まれていたモモ (伊藤沙莉) は、締め切り15分前に進捗を確認され、しどろもどろ状態に…。その矢先、ウメの前で電話に応対し始めたモモは、資料提出がギリギリになると言っている通話相手に対し、「こだわりたいのはわかるけど、完璧主義はよくない」と、ものすごい勢いで熱弁をふるい…!【アレオレ詐欺】モモが「高級なお茶を淹れたので、一緒に飲みませんか?」と、ウメに声をかけた。実のところ、モモがお茶を淹れるのは決まって荒れている時。ウメが指摘すると、モモは「徹夜で作った資料が上の人たちだけの手柄になってて…」と打ち明け、湯呑に怒りのチョップをお見舞い! さらに「こういうのって“アレオレ詐欺”って言うらしい」と具体例を挙げ…!?

Summaries.eng: Momo (Sari Ito) finds a piece of paper on her desk that reads "Lost maidens, meet in conference room 2 at lunchtime". According to Ume (Noriko Eguchi), it is a kind of workshop for girls, and Ume will also attend. Unsure of what is going on, Momo goes to the meeting room with Ume. Then, her sister (Chiaki Kuriyama), who basically never listens to anyone, dashingly appears. She starts talking one-sidedly about the Valentine's Day chocolate..!
Summaries.jpn: モモ（伊藤沙莉）はデスクの上に「迷える乙女、昼休み、第２会議室に集合」と書かれた紙が置いてあるのを発見。ウメ（江口のりこ）によれば、女子向けの講習会みたいなもので、ウメも参加するという。実態がわからないまま、モモはウメと共に会議室へ。すると、基本的に人の話を聞かない姉さん（栗山千明）が颯爽と登場。バレンタインの義理チョコについて一方的に話し出し…！

Summaries.eng: When Momo (Sari Ito) spills the beans about "what is it with people who only say the right things", Ume (Noriko Eguchi) replies, "Ah, 'ceylonists'". Ume (Noriko Eguchi) replies, "Ah, 'Ceylonists'". Surprisingly, Ume admires Ceylonists. Momo, unconvinced, lists examples of savoury ceylonists and asks Ume if she still likes them. Gradually, Ume's tone becomes more and more brusque, and the two begin a heated argument!
Summaries.jpn: モモ（伊藤沙莉）が「正論ばっかり言ってくる人たちって何なんすか」とこぼすと、ウメ（江口のりこ）が「あー“セイロニスト”ね」と返してきた。意外にもウメはセイロニストに憧れるという。納得の行かないモモは、サバサバ系セイロニストの例を列挙し、ウメにそれでも好きか確認。すると、徐々にウメの歯切れが悪くなり、2人のし烈なせめぎあいが始まってしまう！

Summaries.eng: Momo (Sari Ito) is continuously warned by the head of the department (Sarutoki Minagawa). Ume (Noriko Eguchi) witnesses this and asks, "Do you want to talk about it?" (Ito Sari), who witnesses this, asks, "Shall we talk about it?". Momo then hands Ume a handwritten form, saying, "I'm going to report to the director now. And then she suddenly pulled out a mini keyboard and started singing a song of her own composition, summarising what had happened...?
Summaries.jpn: モモ（伊藤沙莉）は続けざまに部長（皆川猿時）に注意されている。それを目撃したウメ（江口のりこ）は「話、聞こうか？」と切り出す。すると、モモが「今から部長の件、報告するので」と言って、ウメに手書きの用紙を手渡してきた。しかも、いきなりミニキーボードを取り出したかと思うと、事の顛末をまとめた自作の歌を歌い始め…!?

Titles.jpn: サクサクのリズムに合わせて

Summaries.eng: Ume (Eguchi Noriko) encounters Momo (Ito Sari) moping around with her good friend and classmate Yocchan (Sheyashi Riho). Ume learns that Yocchan has a character that doesn't complain, and is worried about her mental state. 'If you eat this kind of food, won't you start to have a crunchy giggle or a petulant complaint?' And he takes out a rusk. Yocchan then tries to complain while eating the rusk...?
Summaries.jpn: ウメ（江口のりこ）は、モモ（伊藤沙莉）が仲良し同期のよっちゃん（鞘師里保）とモヤモヤしながらしょんぼりしているところに遭遇する。よっちゃんがグチを言わない性格だと知ったウメは、精神状態を心配。「こういうのを食べたら、サクサクグチとか小言が出てくるんじゃないの？」と、ラスクを取り出す。そこで、よっちゃんはラスクを食べながら、グチを言ってみるのだが…!?

Titles.jpn: マウントバトルロイヤル

Summaries.eng: Momo (Sari Ito) arrives at work after a long time since the self-restraint period ended, and witnesses the Mount Girls (Megu Aoyama) in the water supply room fighting over how to spend the self-restraint period. She immediately tells Ume (Noriko Eguchi) that "in our company, fighting over mounts has been recognised as an official competitive sport", and reports the match she has just seen. Ume is inadvertently taken in, and the two get into a lively tsukkomi match..!
Summaries.jpn: 自粛期間が明け、久々に出社したモモ（伊藤沙莉）は、給湯室でマウント女子（青山めぐ）たちが自粛期間の過ごし方でマウントを取り合う現場を目撃。さっそくウメ（江口のりこ）に「うちの会社では、マウントの取り合いが正式な競技スポーツに認定されたんですよ」と言いながら、さっき見たばかりの試合を報告する。ウメもうっかり乗せられ、２人はツッコミ合戦で盛り上がり…！

Summaries.eng: When Ume (Noriko Eguchi) is told by Momo (Sari Ito), "Lately, I often get told off for speaking from the conclusion," Ume (Noriko Eguchi) replies, "I still think you should speak from the conclusion." Ume (Noriko Eguchi) replied, "I still think it's better to speak from the conclusion. The unusually tense atmosphere unexpectedly gets the two of them excited, and they use the tension as a topic to get into a lively conversation. Momo then asks, "Is it so important to talk about the conclusion?" Momo raises the question: "Is it so important to talk about the conclusion? She develops a philosophical theory...?
Summaries.jpn: モモ（伊藤沙莉）に「最近よく、結論から話せって怒られるんです」と切り出されたウメ（江口のりこ）は「今も結論から話した方がいいんじゃない？」とバッサリ。珍しくピリついた空気に思わず沸いた２人は、ピリつきをネタに、与太話で盛り上がってしまう。そんな中、モモは「結論を話すことがそんなに大事ですかね？」と問題提起。やけに哲学めいた持論を展開し…!?

Titles.jpn: 愛想ヘッドバンギング

Summaries.eng: Momo (Sari Ito) asked Ume (Noriko Eguchi) if there was a good graft clinic near the office. During lunch, her classmates, who were nodding their heads and listening to their seniors, increased their nodding speed and eventually went into a headbanging state, so she thought, "I have to help them as soon as possible!" they thought. Momo's passionate thoughts ran wild, as she was not worried about the cervical vertebrae of her seniors' caring peers. She became intensely delusional...
Summaries.jpn: モモ（伊藤沙莉）がウメ（江口のりこ）に、会社の近くにいい感じの接骨院がないかと聞いてきた。ランチ中にうなずきながら先輩の話を聞いていた同期たちが、うなずき速度をどんどん上げ、最終的にヘッドバンギング状態になっていたため、「早く助けなきゃ！」と思ったらしい。先輩に気を使う同期たちの頚椎が心配でならないモモの、熱い思いは暴走。激しく妄想を膨らませ…。

Summaries.eng: Momo (Sari Ito) asked Ume (Noriko Eguchi), "I feel embarrassed when I use the end of the word 'fortunately' in e-mails and such, but isn't it like that?" (Do you ever feel embarrassed when you use the end of a word like 'Fortunately' in e-mails? She said she felt uncomfortable with the "correct business keigo", which she does not normally use. However, Ume did not sympathise with her at all. So Momo teases him with all the business keigo she can think of..!
Summaries.jpn: モモ（伊藤沙莉）がウメ（江口のりこ）に、「メールとかで語尾に『幸いです』とか使う時、なんか照れるんですけど、そんなことないですか？」と尋ねてきた。普段は使わない“正しいビジネス敬語”に、どうも違和感を覚えているというのだ。ところが、ウメにはちっとも共感してもらえない。そこで、モモは考えつく限りのビジネス敬語を上げてイジり倒し…！

Summaries.eng: When Momo (Sari Ito) asks, "How did you do the printing on one page?" Ume (Noriko Eguchi) asked, "Do you know what they say about people who don't look things up and just ask other people?" Ume (Noriko Eguchi) replies with a question. But... for some reason, Momo replies in an amusing way, as if she were a "good woman", and Ume forgets her anger and laughs at her! ...?
Summaries.jpn: モモ（伊藤沙莉）に「１ページにまとめて印刷って、どういうふうにするんでしたっけ？」と尋ねられたウメ（江口のりこ）は「そういうふうに調べないで、人にばっか聞いてる人のこと何て言うか知ってるの？」と質問返し。ところが…なぜか“いい女”風に、おもしろ返しをしてきたモモに、ウメは怒るのも忘れ大ウケ！２人は“自分で調べない人”をネタに俄然盛り上がり…!?

Summaries.eng: While the employees around her have their eyes bawling with confirmed overtime, Momo (Sari Ito) throws her work away and proudly announces to Ume (Noriko Eguchi) when she reaches her regular hours that she is going home. When Ume tries to stop her, Momo says, "The reason we work so much overtime is because the company hasn't made progress with IT. Our company is on the losing side of the IT gap", and emphasises that going home on time is a "silent protest against the company". Ume-san is not dissatisfied?" He then asks, "Are you not satisfied?
Summaries.jpn: 周りの社員たちが残業確定で目がバッキバキになる中、定時を迎えたモモ（伊藤沙莉）は仕事を投げ出し、堂々とウメ（江口のりこ）に帰宅を宣言する。引き止めようとするウメに、モモは「残業が多いのは会社のIT化が進んでないせい。うちの会社はIT格差の負け組」と息巻き、定時帰宅を「会社への無言の抗議」と強調。「ウメさんは不満ないんすか？」と食ってかかるのだが…!?

Summaries.eng: About two years ago - Ume (Noriko Eguchi) and Ringo (Asako Ito), who works in the president's office, find new employee Momo (Sari Ito) crying by herself. Ume asks Momo, who says she "stumbled on her first day at the company", what happened. Momo confesses that she has been bluffing and bluffing since her first day at the company, but it hasn't worked out. Ume and Ringo can't stop laughing when they hear about all the bluffs she has put up so far...
Summaries.jpn: 今から約２年前――ウメ（江口のりこ）と社長室勤務のりんご（いとうあさこ）は、ひとりで泣いている新入社員のモモ（伊藤沙莉）を発見。「入社早々につまずいた」というモモに、ウメは何があったのか尋ねる。すると、モモは「入社初日から虚勢という虚勢をぶちかましてたけど、うまくいかない」と告白。これまで張った虚勢の数々を聞いたウメとりんごは、笑いが止まらず…。

Summaries.eng: Momo (Sari Ito), Ume (Noriko Eguchi) and Ringo (Asako Ito) hit it off and go to their second pub. Momo (Sari Ito), who has completely let her guard down, becomes very talkative and starts to aggressively attack the two senpai (senior students). She also puts herself on the back burner and says, "I don't like people who come on to me when I first meet them. Ume and Ringo are amused and take the role of listeners, and start complaining about the fact that they have been "allowed" to call her by her nickname by a colleague they have never met before...
Summaries.jpn: 意気投合したモモ（伊藤沙莉）とウメ（江口のりこ）、りんご（いとうあさこ）は二軒目の居酒屋へ。すっかり気を許したモモはじょう舌になり、先輩２人にグイグイいく。しかも、自分のことは棚に上げ「初対面なのにグイグイ来る人って苦手なんですよ」と吐露。面白がって聞き手役に回ったウメとりんごに、初対面の同期からあだ名呼びを“許可”された件について愚痴り始め…。

Summaries.eng: Momo (Sari Ito) is brooding as the bonus payment date approaches. Ume (Noriko Eguchi) says: "I've never seen an office worker who is excited about her bonus and uses it in a good way. It's all gone." Momo then says that she too is like that. Momo then says that she has been in such a situation herself, and she recounts her experience, saying, "The scary thing is when you don't remember what you spent it on". Momo asks Ume how she spent her bonus...?
Summaries.jpn: ボーナス支給日が近づき、うかれるモモ（伊藤沙莉）。ウメ（江口のりこ）は「ボーナスにときめいて、いい使い方するＯＬを見たことない。だいったい霧散」と言い放つ。すると、モモが自分もそういうことがあると言い、「怖いのが、何に使ったのか記憶がない時です」と、経験談を語りだした。モモはボーナスの使い道をウメに尋ねるのだが…!?

Titles.jpn: なんぼのもんじゃい低気圧

Summaries.eng: One day in the middle of the rainy season, Momo (Sari Ito) arrives at work with a clenched face. After reading a special feature on strong women in a magazine, Momo decides to stop lamenting about the hardships of the rainy season and tries hard to suppress her complaints about the harmful effects of the low pressure. Ume (Noriko Eguchi), seeing this, suggested that Momo should train herself to change her words into positive ones, instead of suppressing her emotions. Momo immediately puts this into practice...?
Summaries.jpn: 梅雨の最中のある日、モモ（伊藤沙莉）が食いしばった顔で出社した。雑誌で強い女特集を読んだモモは、梅雨のつらさを嘆くのをやめると決意し、低気圧が招く弊害に対するグチを必死で抑え込んでいたのだ。その姿を見たウメ（江口のりこ）は「感情を押し殺すのではなく、発する言葉をポジティブに変えていく訓練をした方がいい」と提案。モモはさっそく実践してみるが…!?

Titles.eng: Shihan-dai in a clash with a teacher
Titles.jpn: ぶつかり稽古の師範代

Summaries.eng: When Momo (Sari Ito) says she no longer knows how to write a report, Ume (Noriko Eguchi) says, "Why don't you just write it normally?" Ume (Noriko Eguchi) advises, "Why don't you just write it in a normal way? Then Momo suddenly started screaming and shaking. When Ume asks what happened, she learns that every time Momo submits something, Nakayama of the General Affairs Section calls her "normally". Momo is frightened, saying, "That's just like a teacher in a clash. She is frightened, and begins to fantasise about what might happen if she doesn't...
Summaries.jpn: 報告書の書き方がわからなくなったというモモ（伊藤沙莉）に、ウメ（江口のりこ）は「普通に書けばいいんじゃない？」と助言。すると、モモが急にわめいて震えだした。驚いたウメが事情を聴くと、モモは何か提出するたび、庶務課の中山から「普通は」を連呼されるらしい。「あれはまさに“ぶつかり稽古の師範代”」と怯えるモモ。「このままじゃまずい」と、あらぬ妄想を始め…。

Titles.jpn: 先輩に声をかけるときは

Summaries.eng: Ume (Noriko Eguchi) is busy working when Momo (Sari Ito) asks her, "Can I ask you a quick giggle question?" She asked. Ume cautions her that "how to talk to busy seniors is actually a pretty important business skill, so you should learn it a bit better" and teaches her a specific way to talk to them. However, no matter how many times she tries again, Momo always ends up talking to him in an off-the-wall way...
Summaries.jpn: 忙しそうに仕事をしているウメ（江口のりこ）に、モモ（伊藤沙莉）が「ちょっとグイグイ質問してもいいですか？」と声をかけてきた。ウメは「忙しい先輩への話しかけ方って、実は結構大事なビジネススキルだから、もう少しちゃんと覚えた方がいいよ」と注意し、具体的な声のかけ方を教える。ところが、何回やり直しても、モモはついついトンチンカンな声がけをしてしまい…。

Summaries.eng: Momo (Sari Ito) is working overtime to rave reviews next to Ume (Noriko Eguchi) as she prepares to leave. Her boss asks her to prepare a document by next week, and when she tries to make herself comfortable, she is suddenly told she has until tomorrow morning to do it. Momo is upset and says, "A boss who repeatedly does that is called a 'chorebokkuri'. She says she has been taking care of herself in a "certain way" so that she doesn't become one of them..!
Summaries.jpn: 帰り支度をするウメ（江口のりこ）の隣で、絶賛残業中のモモ（伊藤沙莉）。上司から来週までに資料を作るよう頼まれ、余裕をこいていたら、急に明日の朝まで作るように言われたらしい。「そういうことを繰り返す上司を“チョレボックリ”というんですよ」と憤慨するモモ。自分もチョレボックリの仲間入りしないよう、“ある方法”で気をつけていると言い出して…！

Titles.eng: A gift from our forefathers to the future
Titles.jpn: 先人達から未来へのプレゼント

Summaries.eng: We work too hard, don't we? Not so much us, but us human beings", Momo (Sari Ito) asks a grand question. Ume (Noriko Eguchi) is a little surprised. Momo then sniffs, "I think humans have developed various things to make life easier", she continues. Ume calmly replies, "Shouldn't we be grateful?" Momo was disappointed by this reaction. She then snorted even harder and developed her own theory..!
Summaries.jpn: 「私たち、働きすぎじゃないですか？ 私たちっていうより、我々人類が」モモ（伊藤沙莉）の壮大な問いかけに、「？」なウメ（江口のりこ）。すると、モモが鼻息荒く「人間ってラクするために、いろんなものを開発したと思うんですよ」と続けた。ウメは冷静に「感謝すべきじゃない？」と切り返すが、このリアクションにモモはガッカリ。さらに鼻息を荒げ、持論を展開し…！
